close_reason: FIXME comment at lichen_link_tx.c (tdma_tx_allowed(&ctx->tdma, 0) site) expanded to document the integration hazard: exact data window [slot_start, slot_start+d-g) makes the synced gate schedule-dependent; constant now_ms=0 is only correct while ctx->tdma.synced is false (unsynced gate passes unconditionally); once synced, now_ms=0 maps every nonzero schedule position to a huge modular offset -> gate fails with -EBUSY, sole exception being the slot_start==0 special case (superframe==0 AND slot==0) whose window [0, d-g) contains 0 and alone stays open; a real monotonic clock source is REQUIRED before enabling synced operation. Comment-only change, no behavior edit. Verified: clang -fsyntax-only -Wall -Wextra exit 0 on lichen_link_tx.c; ASan/UBSan harness (real tdma.c/link_ctx.c/tx_queue.c) ALL CHECKS PASSED.
